data.decision: Before filing any task or bug: (1) search existing tasks/bugs for duplicates or closable overlaps; (2) check what is already planned; (3) identify reusable/extensible core modules; (4) reuse prior research/best-practice, never re-derive; (5) ask the operator only when a decision needs a person; (6) add wave tag, needs dependencies, correct phase (create one if none fits). Standard rule for this project and every ddflow-managed project.
data.title: Pre-file triage is the default for filing tasks and bugs

data.body: Extend the shipped ddflow rules so every managed project treats pre-file triage as the default when adding a task or bug: (1) check existing tasks/bugs for duplicates or closable overlaps; (2) check what is planned; (3) identify reusable/extensible core modules; (4) reuse prior research, never re-derive; (5) ask the operator only for person-decisions; (6) add wave tag + needs deps + correct phase (create one if none fits). Covers the duplicated-check part already in BL-no-duplicates; this loads the full checklist into the standard rule surface (help text + AGENTS.md rule block), with a parity test that the text ships. Tests first.
data.title: Ship pre-file triage as a standard rule for every ddflow-managed project

data.claim: ScheduleConfig has no order or order_pin knob; D-priority-semantics cites schedule.order which does not exist. D-priority-semantics-2 (accepted) requires: offer by the keys of schedule.order left-to-right; default recover_first,bugs_first,unphased_first,priority,id; critical_path/waited/phase_priority/wave selectable not default; id always last; unknown/repeated keys refused; order_pin tighten-only across layers.
data.falsifier: If ScheduleConfig already declared an order knob, the claim is refuted.
data.mechanism: core/schedule/_filters.py hardcodes ORDER with no config selecting it; config_sections/schedule.py exposes bugs_first/optimizer but no order/order_pin knob.
data.probe: grep order/order_pin in config_sections/schedule.py pre-fix vs running tests/test_schedule_order_knob.py (added by the fix commits).
data.probe_output: pre-fix no order/order_pin knob; post-fix tests/test_schedule_order_knob.py 13 passed
data.question: Which schedule knob does D-priority-semantics cite that does not exist, and what does the accepted D-priority-semantics-2 require?

evidence.note: CONFIRMED (Rd0a50924be): ScheduleConfig had no order/order_pin knob; D-priority-semantics-2 spells the design. Fix = the SCHED-order-knob commits (cb41bf529 merge helper + order/order_pin knob), cherry-picked into ddflow/fix-B0db4e156e8 as 17f599aab+3db982a8d.

D-priority-semantics-2 (accepted) governs ddflow/core/schedule/_filters.py and ddflow/config_sections/schedule.py; the diff implements exactly its knob design. r-everything-configurable + r-company-workflows satisfied (order/order_pin are user/company knobs); r-bounded-everything (id always last, unknown/repeated refused).
